text:
mina: hey team, first morning - Okta link worked but after signing in I get a device-compliance block: 'Enroll a compliant MFA device' and 1Password shows 'account not provisioned'. my yubikey is delayed. who do I ping for a temp workaround?
jena-peopleops: welcome @mina! sorry for the rough start. we can temporarily allow platform passkeys or issue a rotated password + short-lived 1Password vault share. do you prefer passkey or a temp password? :wave:
mina: passkey would be great (macbook). also need repo access for onboarding exercises.
sam-eng: passkeys are fine short-term. i'll add you to onboarding-readers and the repo once your GitHub user is provisioned. DM me your public SSH key.
security: quick note: passkeys allowed for 72h for new hires, but device must have disk encryption enabled. if you can confirm FileVault is on we'll grant the exception.
mina: FileVault is on, enabled earlier tonight. adding pub key now.
sam-eng: got it, adding SSH key and granting read access. try cloning in a minute.
ops-bot: ticket ONB-56021 opened for device-compliance block and 1Password provisioning. assigned to people-ops & infra. ETA 30m.
jena-peopleops: seat added for 1Password, reregistering Okta device policy to allow platform passkey for your account. should propagate in ~5m.
mina: tried `op signin` and it still says 'account not provisioned' after the seat was added.
sam-eng: sometimes 1Password needs the team URL pre-added. try:
```
op account add --team-url https://redwood.1password.com
op signin redwood
```
mina: ran that and `op signin` worked! I can see the onboarding vault. clone also worked (`git clone git@github.com:redwood/onboarding.git`). thanks.
jena-peopleops: yubikey tracking DM sent; keep the passkey until it arrives. i'll also DM a checklist for CISO-specific items.
it-bot: ONB-56021 updated: passkey exception applied, seat assigned, SSH access granted. resolved at 2732109910.
mina: everything green now. much appreciated :tada:
